name: Charleville
source:
"Bonjour. I'm Charleville.
I'm a musket born in France.

I'm quite an old gun among military firearms,
so I don't think I'll be very useful on today's battlefields, but...

As long as you need me, Master, I'll always be by your side.
Looking forward to working with you, Master."
translation:
"Bonjour. I'm Charleville.
